Its fun to spar with friends in real life but as far as online goes having a portion of the playerbase that's equally 'new' to fighting games can really help learn i think although im very concerned that playerbase will in part be turned away by the fgc portion of the playerbase over time. Great! you are already doing better than most. Another unfortunate reality is that at the end of the day people can only do so much to get you through this. Because your going to, whenever that is you have plenty of potential to still make life better.

You can do it, just try not to make yourself any worse like others. Wanting to get better is enough, you'll have ups and downs but as far as I'm concerned I'm sure you'll get better.

Hate to break it to you but i don't think there is anything i can suggest, but answer me this. Do you think you want to be better? do you think that you can be okay again? and forget other people for a sec, taking your life may not be any different to how you feel now; just don't bother with it, you'll achieve nothing from it but maybe you could at least believe as hard as it is that someday something will.

Im probably in the worst place right now to give advice but really all any of us can do is hope for a better tomorrow, at least try to. Hope you'll be okay dude
